state.persona: Tech-savvy traveler (Maya, 34, Brooklyn) who uses Claude or ChatGPT daily and wants their own AI assistant to set up their dope.travel profile over MCP and then plan a Lisbon trip with husband and 6-year-old daughter.
state.flow: Traveler opened the private import link their AI gave them. Page before saving: eyebrow "FROM YOUR AI AGENT", headline "Here’s you, as your agent sees you.", lede "Check it over. Saving keeps it on this device only; dope.travel never received this profile, because it traveled in the link itself." Bento board of their profile. Buttons: "Save my profile", "Plan a trip with it →", "Edit by talking". FACT: the AI agent actually sent the full profile (and the full ramble text) to dope.travel's /api/mcp server to build this link; the server did not store it.
state.after_clicking_save: Entire page content becomes only: "FROM YOUR AI AGENT" and headline "Saved. Your profile is on this device." No buttons, no links, no next step (only the global nav: World, Circles, People, Trips, Access, Search, Now, Profile; the "Profile" nav item opens /account which says "Membership is not connected yet."). The saved board is actually listed at /moodboard under "Boards on this device".

never_received_accurate.instructions: How accurate is "dope.travel never received this profile" given the FACT?

after_save_next_step.instructions: Probability the traveler, after pressing Save, finds their saved profile again or proceeds to plan a trip within one minute.

criteria.dead_end: user is stranded without a next action
criteria.weak: next step exists but is hidden
